title: HCP Engagement Regulations — Western Europe (Q4 2024)
summary: Regulatory requirements for HCP/HCO engagement and meeting sponsorship across Western European countries, current as of Q4 2024. Updated thresholds and clarified rules from 2022 edition. Many Western European countries maintain strict pre-approval or notification requirements.

findings.name: Austria
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma, Medical Devices. Competent authority: Pharmig. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract clearly defining service, remuneration, scope, type, and purpose. Notification/pre-approval: Not applicable. Meetings: Companies may sponsor or organize meetings in suitable venue; documentation required. Notification: Event can be held even if confirmation from congress organizer has not been obtained. Meal thresholds: Lower than 85 EUR incl. VAT and/or charges and gratuities (unchanged from 2022).

findings.name: Belgium
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma, Medical Devices. Competent authority: FAMHP, MDEON. Law and Code regulation. Engagement: Written contract with reasonable fees and legitimate need. Pre-approval: Visa (V) required — V1 to sponsor HCPs, V2 to provide financial support to organizer — for physical and virtual meetings (when event lasts several consecutive calendar days). Submission: Digital-manual via MDEON website. Timelines — Ordinary: Submit 15 working days prior, decision within 5 working days. Urgency: Submit by noon second working day before event, decision by midnight before start. Meal thresholds: Lunch 45 EUR incl. VAT for multi-day events (subject to visa procedure), 23 EUR/hr with maximum 45 EUR for stand-alone events; Dinner 90 EUR incl. VAT for multi-day events, 23 EUR/hr with maximum 90 EUR for stand-alone events (increased from 40/80 EUR in 2022). Additional: Value per day maximum of 45 EUR (lunch) and 90 EUR (dinner) only if programme includes at least 6 hours of scientific activities.

findings.name: Denmark (Pharma — Government)
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma-Generics. Competent authority: Danish Medicines Agency/Ministry of Health, ENLI. Engagement: Written contract required; companies must inform HCPs of duty to notify or seek permission. Engagements limited to teaching/training or research. Notification (Declaration): HCPs notifying Danish Medicines Agency of financial support for professional activities abroad. Pre-approval (Authorization): Required for doctors, dentists, pharmacists. Submission: Electronic. Meetings: Notify ENLI of events organized directly or through third party, including exhibition stands. Notification: Event can proceed without ENLI answer. Meeting timelines — Pharma organized: 10 working days prior. Third party: 10 working days after binding promise. Meal thresholds: Lunch 450 DKK (60 EUR); Dinner 850 DKK (114 EUR); Value per day 1,400 DKK (188 EUR) incl. VAT (increased from 830 DKK dinner/1,600 DKK per day in 2022).

findings.name: Denmark (Medical Devices)
findings.detail: Industry: Medical Devices. Competent authority: Danish Medicines Agency, Medicoindustrien. Same engagement rules as Pharma. HCP employer notification required. Pre-approval (Authorization): Third Party Organized Educational Events via Conference Vetting System (CVS). Submission: Electronic (Online platform). Meeting timelines: Authorization must be granted before engagement. Meal thresholds: Lunch 450 DKK (60 EUR); Dinner 850 DKK (114 EUR); Value per day 1,400 DKK (188 EUR) incl. VAT.

findings.name: France
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma, Medical Devices, Generics, Animal Health. Competent authority: Ministere des Affaires Sociales et de la Sante. Law-based regulation. Engagement: Companies must notify or request authorization before providing benefits to HCPs/Students/Associations. Notification (Declaration): Required for agreements at or below legal thresholds; authority (CNO/ARS) may issue non-binding recommendations. Pre-approval (Authorization): Required above thresholds; two months to respond, deemed granted if no response. Submission: Electronic. Employer authorization: Required for public entity HCPs. Meetings: Same notification/authorization required for sponsoring HCPs. Meeting notification timelines: Declaration must be submitted eight (8) working days prior (reduced from 28 working days in 2022). Pre-approval: Two months from receipt. Meal thresholds: 60 EUR incl. VAT (increased from 50 EUR excl. VAT in 2022).

findings.name: Germany
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma-Generics. Competent authority: FSA. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract required; hospital HCPs require written approval from supervisor/hospital administrator. Pre-approval: Authorization required for hospital HCPs. Meetings: International events must be notified by FSA members to affiliated company in host country. Notification: Required. Meeting timelines: No deadline set. Meal thresholds: 75 EUR incl. VAT (increased from 60 EUR in 2022).

findings.name: Greece
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma, Medical Devices, Generics, Animal Health. Competent authority: EOF, SFEE. Law and Code regulation. Engagement: Written contract; advisory board HCPs in public entity need authorization. Application to EOF for registration-fee events. Pre-approval: Required for public entity HCP advisory boards. Employer authorization: Required. Timelines: Two months prior. Meetings: Must request EOF authorization. Pre-approval: Event must be approved by EOF. Meeting submission: Digital-manual on EOF. Meeting timelines: Two months prior. Meal thresholds: 70 EUR incl. VAT per day (domestic); 150 EUR incl. VAT per day (meetings outside Greece) — international threshold is new in 2024. Additional: SFEE provides maximum fees per year per type of engagement. Limits on HCPs sponsored (number per event, quantity per year per HCP, per type of event) for virtual scientific meetings.

findings.name: Iceland
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: Frumtok. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract required. Meetings: Written agreement required for events requiring travel abroad. Meal thresholds: Lunch/light refreshments ISK 7,500 (50 EUR); Dinner ISK 20,000 (135 EUR) incl. VAT. Breakfast threshold removed in 2024 edition.

findings.name: Ireland
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: IPHA. Code-based regulation. Standard engagement rules with written contract. Meetings: Standard sponsorship rules. Meal thresholds: 80 EUR incl. VAT excl. gratuities (unchanged from 2022).

findings.name: Italy (Government — Pharma-Generics)
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma-Generics. Competent authority: AIFA, Farmindustria. Law and Code regulation. Engagement: Written contract required; public HCP supervisor authorization required (30-day deemed-negative rule). Pre-approval: Required for public entity HCPs. Meetings: AIFA authorization required. Meeting submission: Digital-manual on AIFA website. Meeting timelines: Request 60 days prior; AIFA has 45 days. Meal thresholds: 70 EUR (unchanged). Additional: 10% of annual HCP participants should be under 40. CME events for public HCPs require request to public employer 60 days prior (30-day deemed-consent if no response). Companies must communicate amounts paid to public HCP employer within 15 days.

findings.name: Italy (Medical Devices)
findings.detail: Industry: Medical Devices. Competent authority: Confindustria Dispositivi Medici (CDM). Engagement: Written contract; public HCP supervisor authorization required (30-day rule). Meetings: Companies may sponsor national third-party educational events via CDM Conference Evaluation System (SVC). Cannot sponsor HCPs directly — support goes to entity or third-party organizer. Pre-approval: SVC positive evaluation required. Meeting submission: Digital-manual on SVC platform (CDM website). Meeting timelines: Request by third-party organizer 60 days prior; SVC decision within 20 days. Meal thresholds: 70 EUR (new explicit threshold in 2024).

findings.name: Netherlands
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: CGR. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract clearly defining object, execution, payment (hours and fee); maximum rates for hospitalities provided by Code. Sponsorship of hospitality: per HCP not exceeding 500 EUR per event or 1,500 EUR per year. Meetings: International events require preliminary opinion from CGR (not binding). Exceptions: international events organized by independent scientific bodies, or content qualified as scientific by independent body. Meeting submission: Email to CGR. Meeting timelines: CGR provides opinion within approximately 6 weeks. Meal thresholds: 75 EUR incl. VAT (unchanged from 2022).

findings.name: Norway
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: LMI. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract required. Pre-approval: Advisory board HCPs require employer authorization (responsibility lies on the HCP). Meetings: Companies may organize or support events. Hospitality expenses only for company-organized events or consultancy arrangements. Meal thresholds: 299 NOK (25 EUR) for shorter meetings (min 45 min or at workplace); 1,298 NOK (111 EUR) for meetings over 90 min/typical dinner (increased from 250/400 NOK in 2022).

findings.name: Portugal
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: APIFARMA, INFARMED. Law and Code regulation. Engagement: Written contract required; NHS hospital support requires MOH authorization. Pre-approval: Required for NHS hospitals; engagement only if no doubt regarding impartiality/neutrality. Submission: Electronic via INFARMED. Meetings: APIFARMA members may organize or support events; cannot sponsor events in NHS establishments. Meal thresholds: 60 EUR incl. VAT (unchanged).

findings.name: Spain
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: Farmaindustria. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract; agreements must be approved by company's scientific department or Compliance Officer appointee. Meetings — Domestic: Events with overnight stay involving 20+ Spanish HCPs must be communicated to Surveillance Unit. Notification: 10 working days prior; if no answer within 5 working days, deemed approved. International: Must be authorized by Surveillance Unit if justified to be held abroad. Submission: Email and Electronic via Farmaindustria website. Meal thresholds: 70 EUR incl. VAT (increased from 60 EUR excl. VAT in 2022).

findings.name: Sweden
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma-Generics. Competent authority: LIF. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract; HCPs employed by HCO require tripartite contract (Company, HCP, HCO/employer). Expenses must follow HCO's internal rules. Pre-approval: Employer authorization required via written contract. Meetings: Companies may organize or sponsor events; may finance venue, speaker costs, meals, training materials. Companies NOT allowed to pay registration fees, travel, or accommodation for participating HCPs (stricter than 2022). Meal thresholds: Lunch 350 SEK (30 EUR); Dinner 950 SEK (80 EUR) incl. VAT (increased from 300/800 SEK in 2022). Additional: LIF ethical rules also followed by FGL (Generic/Biosimilar association).

findings.name: Switzerland
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma-Generics. Competent authority: Scienceindustries, FOPH. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract ensuring legitimate need, qualified HCPs, appropriate number, records maintained. Meetings: HCP contribution requirements — Fully qualified: at least 1/3 total cost; Post-graduate training: at least 1/5; No contribution for events under half working day without overnight stay (unchanged from 2022). Meal thresholds: 100 CHF incl. VAT (unchanged).

findings.name: United Kingdom
findings.detail: Industry: Pharma. Competent authority: ABPI. Code-based regulation. Engagement: Written contract required. Meetings: All meetings involving travel outside UK (unless company only supports a speaker) must be certified in advance. Events must have clear educational content, appropriate venue; companies must not sponsor entertainment. International events must be notified to relevant local subsidiary. Meal thresholds: 75 GBP (84 EUR) plus VAT and gratuities, appropriate only in exceptional circumstances (unchanged from 2022).
